# Fix dry-run resolution

## Problem

`adv_change_archive dryRun:true` skips required ops-link reconciliation to preserve read-only behavior. It therefore renders the stale parent snapshot and incorrectly blocks valid preflight even when the authoritative child is complete.

## Root Cause Analysis

The first resolver implementation correctly avoided signals in dry-run mode but used stale parent links directly instead of deriving fresh child proof in memory. Non-dry authority reconciles and persists; dry-run did neither. This violates C6’s archive-preflight proof requirement while preserving zero-write semantics.

## Direction

Use a shared authoritative child-resolution routine. Non-dry authority persists then re-reads. Dry-run creates a non-aliasing, ephemeral overlay for readiness/obligation rendering only—zero signals, saves, disk writes, parent mutation, or reusable proof.

## Success

- Completed child clears stale parent snapshot in dry-run preflight.
- Incomplete, unreachable, or mismatched child remains blocked with matching non-dry blocker code.
- Dry-run leaves every persisted object unchanged.
- Live PokeEdge preflight clears before parent release/archive.
documents.problemStatement: After deploying the first resolver, live PokeEdge archive dry-run still reports completed child `verifyStagingBuildkit` as `not_started` because dry-run reads stale parent snapshot and intentionally does not signal persistence.
documents.agreement:
# Agreement

## Objective

Make archive dry-run/preflight derive authoritative child ops resolution without any persisted mutation.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Given a stale parent required link and complete authoritative child proof, dry-run returns no required open obligation.
- Given incomplete, missing, unreachable, or identity-mismatched child proof, dry-run returns the same fail-closed blocker as non-dry authority.
- Dry-run sends zero signals, saves zero state, writes zero disk projections, and leaves parent/link input objects unchanged.
- Same-project and cross-project coverage exists.
- Live PokeEdge `pinBuildkitImage` archive dry-run clears completed `verifyStagingBuildkit` obligation.

## Constraints

- Temporal workflows remain deterministic; child reads stay host-side and Temporal-authoritative.
- Overlay is non-aliasing; no cache or caller mutation.
- No state-file edits, TTL reuse, status inference, or signal during dry-run.

## Out of Scope

- Redesigning ops links or relationship kinds.
- Bulk backfill.
- Changing PokeEdge deployment evidence.
documents.design:
# Design

## Shared resolution phase

Host-only `resolveRequiredOpsLinks(parent, authority)` derives a fresh `resolutionByLinkId` for **every** required link on every call. It canonicalizes target path, validates project identity, reads child through Temporal authority only, and derives `child_profile` or fail-closed `unreachable`/incomplete proof. It never trusts, merges with, or preserves existing parent resolution; fresh results overwrite stale `complete`, stale `not_started`, and absent resolution alike.

## Non-dry authority

Release/non-dry archive signals fresh resolution per exact link ID, then re-reads parent before blockers. Workflow reducer remains deterministic and updates only the link resolution.

## Dry-run authority

Dry-run calls the same derive phase, then `overlayOpsResolutionsForRead(parent, resolutionByLinkId)`. It returns a new parent view with a new links array, cloned links, and cloned replacement resolutions. The overlay never aliases or mutates input parent, cached links, nested resolutions, workflow state, disk projection, or Temporal history. It is discarded after readiness/obligation rendering.

## Parity and failure

Dry-run and non-dry use the same fresh derivation and blocker mapping. A stale complete parent followed by unreachable current child must produce `OPS_FOLLOWUP_STATUS_UNVERIFIED`; incomplete proof uses `OPS_FOLLOWUP_COMPLETION_PROOF_INCOMPLETE`. Only non-dry persists/re-reads.

## Tests

- Freeze input parent/links/resolutions; assert no mutation or aliasing.
- Assert zero signals, saves, projection writes, and history mutation for every dry-run outcome.
- Same/cross project complete, incomplete, missing child/profile, target mismatch, unreachable, and stale-complete/current-unreachable cases.
- Assert dry/non-dry blocker and obligation parity; assert persistence only non-dry.
- Live AC5/C6 is valid only through Temporal-authoritative PokeEdge `pinBuildkitImage` archive dry-run. It must show complete `verifyStagingBuildkit` proof, no required open obligation, and no dry-run side effect. Disk snapshot cannot satisfy it.
documents.executiveSummary:
## Executive Summary: fixDryRunResolution

### Outcome
Archive dry-run preflight (`adv_change_archive dryRun:true`) now correctly clears stale required ops-follow-up obligations when the authoritative child change is complete, instead of reading a stale parent snapshot and falsely blocking valid archives.

### Value / Why it matters
Deploying the first ops-link resolver created a paradox: dry-run preflight (which must not write) skipped reconciliation entirely, so a parent change whose snapshot still showed a `not_started` child link was blocked from archiving even after the child completed. This blocked the live PokeEdge `pinBuildkitImage` → `verifyStagingBuildkit` release chain. The fix derives fresh authoritative child proof on every call and applies it via a non-aliasing ephemeral overlay — zero writes, same fail-closed parity as the wet (persisting) path.

### What was built
- `resolveRequiredOpsLinks` — shared host-only fresh per-link derivation of authoritative child proof. No signals, no saves. Used by both dry-run and wet paths.
- `overlayOpsResolutionsForRead` — non-aliasing ephemeral overlay via `structuredClone` (parent AND replacement resolutions), discarded after readiness/obligation rendering.
- `reconcileOpsFollowupLinks` — refactored to delegate to the shared derive, then persist + re-read (wet path only).
- `adv_change_archive` authority — dryRun branch calls resolve + overlay (zero writes); wet branch calls reconcile (signal + re-read).

### Verification
- 184 unit tests pass: 152 in `change.test.ts` (11 new: stale-clear, incomplete/missing/unreachable/identity-mismatch/stale-complete-current-unreachable/completion-proof-incomplete, cross-project clear+blocker, non-aliasing freeze, dry/wet parity) + 32 in `ops-followup-reconciliation.test.ts` (30 existing preserved under refactor + 2 new overlay non-aliasing regression).
- `pnpm run check` clean (schemas, typecheck, manifests, isolation, lint, formatting).
- Independent acceptance review: READY after C2 aliasing remediation (commit `6733dba8` — clone replacement resolutions before assignment).

### Risks / Follow-ups
- **AC5 (live PokeEdge proof):** Unit tests prove the code path (AC1 shares the same derive + overlay). The live Temporal-authoritative proof — `adv_change_archive dryRun:true` against `pokeedge-web pinBuildkitImage` — requires a plugin build + deploy first; captured at archive preflight. Cannot be unit-tested per design.
- **Plugin deploy required:** Fix takes effect only after `pnpm run build` + `deploy-local.sh --fix` + host restart. Source edits do not change live `adv_*` behavior until deployed.
